mutations.label: LA #510 REVERTED: nothing counts as never-run, so a re-authored chain that never ran blocks exactly like one that ran and broke. This is the r84 defect itself -- 11 chains PASSED, 5 were re-authored at the deliver tail and never ran, and business_chain_failing stuck forever, so the milestone gate never cleared and main() exited 1. business_chain_failing blocks in 76 of the corpus runs, more than any other check.
LB everything counts as never-run, so a chain that RAN AND BROKE is excluded from not_passing and stops blocking -- the false-pass this fix had to avoid while excluding the indeterminate ones.

LC the >=1-passing guard is removed. not_passing already excludes never-run chains, so an authored set that is ALL never-run falls through to GREEN with nothing actually verified -- shipping on the strength of chains that were only ever registered.

LD the not_passing test becomes a conjunction, so a chain whose STATUS says failing stops blocking unless its last run also recorded broken steps. `failing` is outside _NOT_A_LANE_FAILURE_1202OF precisely so the status alone is enough.

LE the >=1-passing guard accepts a merely REGISTERED chain as evidence of passing, which is the same hole as removing it: an all-never-run set satisfies the guard that exists to catch exactly that set.

LF the guard stops requiring that the passing chain's last run was not broken, so a chain still LABELLED passing while its last_result recorded broken steps satisfies the guard -- the clause between 'labelled passing' and 'passed'. First run came back MISSED: no fixture built that pairing, and the corpus never produces it (0 of 100 chain registries; observed states are all self-consistent). Defensive, not a live defect -- and given a ratchet anyway (#1203rl).

LG the blocker detail stops quoting the broken step, leaving a message that counts chains but cannot say which step failed -- the only actionable sentence in the gate that blocks more corpus runs than any other. UNREACHABLE BEFORE #1203rl: this file's fixture built `broken` as a BOOL where production writes a LIST (3134 of 3134), so `_first_broken_step_1202ox` raised TypeError, warn_once_1201 swallowed it, and the detail path was never exercised.
